---
name: Scenario or capability proposal
about: Propose a new scenario, view, or modeled behavior for Capital Lab
labels: enhancement
---

## What a reader would learn

Describe the concept the change teaches, and why the current 20 scenarios do not already show it.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the scenario steps, the views affected, and the evidence a reader should be able to inspect
afterwards.

## Modeling honesty

State what would be real, what would be simulated, and what a reader must not conclude from it.
Illustrative rules must stay labeled as illustrative; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/aggarwalpulkit596/capital-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Financial and operational impact

Note any effect on money rules, idempotency, reservations, immutable commands, ledger entries,
policy evidence, recovery, or the database schema. Schema changes append a new migration resource.
